episodes.title: Wildfire (1)
episodes.summary: Kris Furillo is released from the juvenile detention center and begins working at the Ritter family ranch.

episodes.title: The Rescue (2)
episodes.summary: American drama series following troubled teen Kris Furillo - who has a criminal record - as she tries to build a new life for herself by joining Raintree Farm as a stable hand. In this first episode, Kris, begins her new life at the ranch. The Ritter family own the ranch and their fortunes have dwindled in recent years.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.summary: Kris is back at the ranch after her second time in juvenile detention, and Dani is jealous of Matt's romantic interest in Kris.

episodes.title: Mothers
episodes.summary: Kris's mother pays a surprise visit to the ranch to try and get her daughter to come back home with her. Meanwhile, Jean reveals that the farm is having money troubles.

episodes.title: Guilty
episodes.summary: A troubled girl forms a special bond with Wildfire, a failed race horse. Kris takes on a second job in an attempt to help out Raintree with their financial woes, and Matt turns to gambling to make some extra money.

episodes.title: The Claiming Race
episodes.summary: Kris bribes Junior to stake a claim on Wildfire by promising that she will go on a date with him, and Dani finds out that Bobby is married.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.summary: A stampede at the ranch means that several horses have gone missing, and Kris, Dani, Matt and Junior go into the mountains to look for them. Elsewhere, Jean's ex-husband pays her an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: The Track
episodes.summary: Kris and Matt look for the person responsible for some dangerous meddling. Meanwhile, Matt gets further into gambling debt.

episodes.title: The Party
episodes.summary: Matt and Junior throw a party while Jean is away at a horse show; Kris worries about an old friend from the past arriving.

episodes.title: Identity
episodes.summary: Kris trains with a well-known jockey instead of working on her studies, and Dani tries to solve the mystery of her mother's disappearance.

episodes.title: Tina Sharp
episodes.summary: Kris has a chance to ride Wildfire in a race, but is hampered by her broken arm, famous jockey, Tina Sharp, comes back to the ranch to help Kris out, and Dani thinks she may have found her mother.

episodes.title: Impressions
episodes.summary: A television crew is at Raintree to film Tina's training, and Junior invites Kris to his family's house for dinner.

episodes.title: Loyalty
episodes.summary: As Tina rides for a rival family, the decision is made that Kris should ride Wildfire, and Matt resumes his gambling habit.

episodes.title: Try It Without the Porsche!
episodes.summary: Despite their loss in the Sandpiper Classic, Kris and Wildfire get lots of media attention. They also pique the interest of a sports agent. Meanwhile, Junior leaves home, and Kris and Matt go to look for him.

episodes.title: Opportunity Knocks
episodes.summary: Kris's new agent encourages her to audition for a television commercial, sparks fly again between Kris and Junior, and Dani starts up her own stable.

episodes.title: A Good Convict Is Hard to Find
episodes.summary: Kris volunteers at a charity event in a prison and is tempted to go back to her old ways, and Matt and Junior open their new club.

episodes.title: Dangerous Liaisons
episodes.summary: Kris has to call Junior for help when there is a crisis at Raintree. Meanwhile, Jean and Charlie have gone a romantic holiday together, and Matt tries to buy a horse for Dani.

episodes.title: Family Matters
episodes.summary: Matt is training Kris for a race, but he is also working closely with her rival. Plus, Todd tries to cut the apron strings from Jean, and Isabelle's intentions are not what they seem.

episodes.title: Nothing Takes the Past Away Like the Future
episodes.summary: Pablo's past ties to a crime syndicate catch up with him; Ken threatens to reveal the truth about Isabelle's finances; Matt agrees to work for Dani as a full-time trainer.

episodes.title: Taking Off
episodes.summary: Kris goes to work for a famous horse trainer, but the experience is not all that she'd hoped, and one of the residents of Raintree receives a marriage proposal.

episodes.title: Fear
episodes.summary: Kris receives a threat and must ask Ken for help, and Matt learns about an insurance scam involving his former clubs.

episodes.title: Break Down
episodes.summary: Kris finds herself riding in a race against Wildfire, Junior puts his club on the line in a bet, and a major accident occurs, for which Kris blames herself.
A few home truths are revealed when Kris, Junior and Matt find themselves trapped together at Davis Farm during a storm, and Ken is arrested for fraud.

episodes.title: Who Are You
episodes.summary: Kris tries to secure a place for Wildfire in the illustrious Breeders Invitational race, but Dani tries her hardest to thwart Kris's plans.

episodes.title: For Love or Money
episodes.summary: Wildfire and Dani's horse are up against each other for a spot in the Breeders Invitational. Meanwhile, Kerry and Gillian's relationship is reignited.

episodes.title: Close Shave
episodes.summary: Kris faces a tough career choice which may mean leaving Raintree for good. Meanwhile, it's time for the illustrious Breeders Invitational, and Wildfire is competing.

episodes.title: Fairy Tale Endings
episodes.summary: Third series of US teen drama set on a horse ranch. Kris finds out what happened to Kerry, Dani takes over the Davis ranch - but that doesn't stop her Dad from taking over, and Jean has a surprise visit.

episodes.title: The Feud
episodes.summary: Kris resorts to desperate measures in an attempt to ease Raintree's dire financial state, Matt and Dani go head to head to win an important client's custom, and Junior finds old habits hard to break.

episodes.title: Moving On
episodes.summary: Jean and Pablo question whether Kris is pushing Wildfire too hard when she says she wants to get him back on the track.

episodes.title: Close to Home
episodes.summary: Kris's trailer catches fire and she is forced to live at the Ritters' house. Meanwhile, Dani has a new suitor.

episodes.title: Love vs. Work
episodes.summary: Conflict erupts between Kris and Matt when rival horse Avatar trains at Raintree; Dani chooses work over romance during a night out with R.J.

episodes.title: Kiss, Kiss
episodes.summary: Kris, Matt and Junior try to change Ken's mind when he decides to sell Wildfire's son Flame; Dani moves into R.J.'s trailer.

episodes.title: Push Me, Pull You
episodes.summary: Kris feels unsure about her future at Raintree when Gillian moves in with Matt and Junior comes back to the ranch when the Davis clan have a family emergency.

episodes.title: The Goodbye
episodes.summary: Kris and Pablo baulk at Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer to take on the ranch. Meanwhile, Junior and Gillian find common ground in their family histories.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.summary: Kris and Matt take their relationship to the next level but fear Junior's reaction to their affection for one another. Meanwhile, Dani struggles with her grief.

episodes.title: Diplomacy
episodes.summary: Junior is shocked by Kris and Matt's relationship and the search for a new trainer at Raintree causes some kafuffle.

episodes.title: You Can Count on Me
episodes.summary: Kris's attempts to get accustomed to her new surroundings are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half-brother, Jace; She is suspicious of his sudden arrival.

episodes.title: Picking Sides
episodes.summary: The rivalry between Matt and Junior heats up, but the blow is softened somewhat when Gillian returns to town and seeks solace in Junior.

episodes.title: So Long Pardner
episodes.summary: Kris considers an illegal match race between Wildfire and Avatar when the fate of Raintree in trouble.

episodes.title: The More Things Change (1)
episodes.summary: Matt is struggling to cope with the changes at Raintree and Dani is hard at work on a new business venture.

episodes.title: The More Things Change (2)
episodes.summary: Kris returns for a glimpse of Wildfire's next race. At the race, she gains an unlikely ally and a place to stay.

episodes.title: Calm
episodes.summary: Jean and Pablo are adamant that Kris should leave town instead of sticking around and helping to care for Wildfire. Elsewhere, Junior bumps into an old school friend who might have the answers to his financial woes.

episodes.title: Flames
episodes.summary: Kris and Junior help Matt to get Raintree back in the horse-racing business. Meanwhile, Wildfire's condition improves at Dani's clinic.

episodes.title: The Friend
episodes.summary: Junior preoccupies himself with his business proposition and puts his wedding arrangements on the backburner, while Jean criticises Matt's plans for the adopted racehorses.

episodes.title: Friendship/Passion
episodes.summary: Junior is confused about marrying Laura after sharing a kiss with Kris. Elsewhere, Dani considers pursuing a relationship with Noah and Pablo thinks about telling Jean how he feels about her.

episodes.title: Commitment Issues
episodes.summary: Kris fights to get her jockey's licence reinstated as the day of Flame's first professional race approaches. Elsewhere, Paulo's personal life gets in the way of a practical decision.

episodes.title: Life's Too Short
episodes.summary: Kris hopes that Jean will change her mind about Raintree's future after Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes. Meanwhile, Dani and Pablo offer their wisdom to Junior.

episodes.title: Vows
episodes.summary: Kris and Junior decide to get married, but their plans are scuppered when Jean is injured by one of the rescue horses. Elsewhere, Dani rediscovers her love of riding when her dad buys her a new horse.

episodes.title: The Comeback
episodes.summary: Kris and Matt try their hardest to run the ranch in Jean's absence as well as keep up with their training for the next race. Later, Junior and Matt come to blows when some ranch guests go missing.

episodes.title: Being Mrs. Junior
episodes.summary: Junior's family's disapproving attitude of Junior and Kris's wedding plants doubts in Kris's mind about whether she wants to marry Junior and join the Davis family. Meanwhile, Dani's return to racing is plagued by her father's interference.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind (1)
episodes.summary: Kris and Junior consider an opportunity to move to Alaska for a year to work on a geothermal project. Kris also prepares for one last race on Wildfire.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind (2)
episodes.summary: In the series finale, Junior is torn when an urgent matter requires that he be in Alaska and coincides with Kris's race with Wildfire and his wedding.
